features.title: Add terminal selection to chat
features.summary: Attach the selected terminal output to its originating thread as an inspectable draft chip.
reach: fill combobox "Search the command palette" "New terminal"
failureModes: A missing or locked originating composer rejects insertion; selection remains available to retry.

verification.testName: keeps the 1-based buffer line range of the selection
binds each terminal body to the session that owns it
shows no excerpt action until the terminal holds a selection
labels the chip with the terminal line range it came from
reveals the captured output the draft will send

verification.reason: The action needs a drag selection over a live xterm and PTY, and the chip it produces is covered by the component and registration tests here.

telemetry.reason: Client-only selection and draft presentation; no Host work.
